description: Condition Index: an editorial indicator, not a scientific one. Each signal is placed on a 0–100 scale between a 'calm' value (0) and an 'alarm' value (100), clipped at both ends. The index is the weighted average of the signals that have data; missing signals are left out and the remaining weights are rescaled.

signals.name: Conflict in the news
signals.explain: Share of events coded by GDELT in the last 24 hours that are 'material conflict' (assaults, fighting, mass violence). Uses GDELT's 15-minute event files only.

signals.name: Deaths in organised violence
signals.explain: Deaths recorded by UCDP in the latest available month (candidate events, 'best' estimate).

signals.name: Significant earthquakes
signals.explain: Earthquakes the USGS classes as significant in the last 7 days (combines magnitude, damage and felt reports).

signals.name: Active storms and volcanoes
signals.explain: Severe storms and active volcanoes open in NASA EONET. Wildfires are left out: there are always dozens and they would swamp the signal.

signals.name: Pace of AI-attributed job cuts
signals.explain: Last month's job cuts where companies cited AI (Challenger), divided by the average of the previous 12 months. 1 means a normal pace.

signals.name: Doomsday Clock
signals.explain: Seconds to midnight according to the Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists. Fewer seconds, closer to alarm.
